description: Which podcasts a brand advertises on. Returns the shows where that brand's ad reads were detected, newest first, with the exact total even when the list itself is truncated for the plan. Accepts a brand name, slug or domain (a domain is the most reliable). Returns candidate brands when the name is ambiguous.

brand.description: Brand name, slug or domain, e.g. "Squarespace" or "squarespace.com".

name: get_brand_podcasts
title: Podcasts a brand sponsors
